setup.title: Initial setup
setup.hint: Create the admin account for this panel.

navDesc.dashboard: Cluster overview: nodes, live CPU/RAM/net metrics
navDesc.services: Manage services: start/stop, scale, redeploy, image, logs
navDesc.stacks: Stacks — groups of services deployed together
navDesc.events: Live Docker events feed + audit log of your actions
navDesc.disk: Disk usage per node and cleanup (prune)
navDesc.alerts: Notifications: disk full, node down, service degraded

resources.secretHint: The value is sent to Docker once and can never be read back.
resources.secretsNote: Docker secrets are write-only: their values cannot be shown or edited by design. To change a secret, remove it and create a new one, then update the services that use it.

disk.allImages: prune all unused images (not only dangling)
disk.pruneHint: Estimated space to reclaim: {size}. Only unused objects are removed.
disk.noAgents: No agents have reported yet — disk usage is unavailable.

logs.emptyResult: No lines returned for tail={tail}. Try a smaller value; the panel's own logs will show the reason.

services.name: Name
services.stopConfirm: Stop service {name}? (scale to 0, replicas will be remembered)
services.deployHint: The panel will re-pull the latest image for the current tag and roll the service using its stack's update policy (order/parallelism).
services.deployStarted: Deploy started — updating in the background
services.removeHint: Type the service name «{name}» to confirm removal.

stacks.name: Stack
stacks.redeployConfirm: Force redeploy all services of stack {name}?
stacks.deployHint: For each service in the stack the panel will re-pull the latest image for the current tag. The rollout follows the stack's compose update policy and may take a while.
stacks.deployStarted: Stack deploy started — updating in the background
stacks.removeHint: This removes all {count} services of the stack. Type «{name}» to confirm.

settings.refreshHint: How often agents collect and send metrics (1–30 s). This is a server setting — each agent picks it up within ~10 s. Controls the update rate of all live charts.
settings.tokenRotation: Agent token rotation (Docker CLI on a manager node)
settings.regWhat: Credentials for private Docker registries (Docker Hub private, ghcr.io, GitLab, your own). Needed only if your services pull images from a private registry — then pick the registry when updating a service image. For public images you don't need this.

nodes.rotateConfirm: Old tokens will stop working immediately.
nodes.drainConfirm: Drain the node? All tasks will be moved to other nodes.
nodes.removeConfirm: Remove this node from the cluster?
nodes.forceRemoveConfirm: Node is not down! Force-remove it from the cluster?
